source_note: Reviewer decisions: docs/role-atlas/reviews/M7-r1.md must 1 and reviews/M7-r2.md refinements (same-level agreement; Named title-only). Refines P3 only for Account Executive; no inferred scope policy for other roles.
policy: Named customer segment in a verified native title or current owned-customer duty is strong scope. Seniority and years remain weak; common selling duties never assign. Different segment labels at the same level agree; only different levels conflict (M7-r2). Named is strong only in a native title, never alone in a current-duty named account/book. Longest overlapping compound consumes contained aliases.

rows.rationale: Explicit SMB customer scope; the reviewed rubric places this segment at L2.
Commercial is a reviewed L2 customer segment, not a seniority adjective.
The reviewed Velocity sales motion is L2 scope.
Select is a named customer segment at L2, not the verb select.
Mid-Market ownership is the reviewed L3 scope; spelling separators are aliases.
The named Territory customer segment is L3. A Territory role title qualifies; a generic geographic territory/territory plan is common selling context, not a different customer segment.
Enterprise customer ownership is L4, not generic enterprise-software knowledge.
Corporate account ownership is the reviewed L4 segment.
State Enterprise is one compound L4 segment; its contained Enterprise token is not a second signal.
The reviewed compound Public Sector named-account scope is L4; the contained Named token does not imply L5.
Strategic customer/account scope is L5; strategic thinking or strategy work alone is not this segment.
M7-r2: Named / Named Account(s) in a title is L5; named accounts/books in duties are common at L3–L5 and do not establish L5.
Global account/customer ownership is L5; company-global boilerplate does not qualify.
Key account ownership is L5; a key task or key skill is not an account segment.
